scripts.setup: node scripts/setup.mjs && npm install && npm install --prefix app-a && npm install --prefix app-b && npm install --prefix api
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix app-a && npm run build --prefix app-b
scripts.start: concurrently -n ott,dsg,api -c magenta,green,cyan "npm start --prefix app-a" "npm start --prefix app-b" "npm start --prefix api"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ott,dsg,api -c magenta,green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix app-a" "npm run dev --prefix app-b" "npm start --prefix api"
